_note: Colonist roster (Lachlan, 2026-11-19): sixty named people (forty until 2026-11-20), the only named colonists and outsiders a game has. x01-x18 painted; x19-x40 are placeholders (pending: true) drawn as a white blank until the local art session paints them: a file landing at art/colonists/xNN.webp is shown as it is, with no step after (take pending off when it lands). kind: colonist (drawn into a game by LF.makePerson) or outsider (never a colonist: speakers for others). stands: the department this person speaks for when its officer's seat is empty (never drawn for anything else). band: prime 30-40, young, older-prime, older, child, born (born in the colony, only for the born-here cards), outsider. Run node tools/roster.js after any change: it writes js/roster.js.
